question: Which native source MLP amplifies the small rank-16 complement residual that prevents the stable mean+contrast weight union from matching full is-was behavior?
population: Exact transferred temporal-v13/iswas-v12 target and matched-control rows used by the valid v2 screen; no basis refit or threshold change.
intervention: At one named source MLP, install its exact orthogonal complement block while every other source MLP retains the frozen mean+contrast union; execute complete-model target and control patches.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_closure_finitene: All hashes match; union/full replay v2 within 1e-5; union+complement closes each site's rank16 write within 1e-6; all metrics finite; <=44 model forwards.
predictions.pred_b_one_site_explains_most_missing_is: At least one singleton add-back recovers >=60% of the full-minus-union is-was behavior gap while remaining functional on both tasks.
predictions.pred_c_residual_localization_is_not_line: The top behavioral add-back is not selected merely by largest signed linear-response increment: its is-was behavior recovery exceeds its response recovery by >=.015, confirming downstream nonlinear amplification.
predictions.pred_d_singletons_add_no_new_parent_coll: Every singleton's flipped controls are a subset of the union of the frozen union/full flip sets, median KL <= full+.002, and each task margin-RMS <= full+.02.
predictions.pred_e_singleton_effects_license_greedy_: The sum of five singleton behavior increments predicts the full-minus-union increment within .015 on both tasks, consistent with the prior .00138 source-site interaction bound.

terminal_policy.localized_nonlinear_complement_site: A-E pass; freeze the singleton ordering for a prospective greedy add-back.
terminal_policy.distributed_additive_complement: A, D, and E pass but B or C fails; freeze a multi-site greedy order rather than claiming one nonlinear site.
terminal_policy.conditional_complement_interaction: A passes but E fails; run a bounded pairwise factorial rather than greedy composition.
terminal_policy.selectivity_blocked_residual: A passes but D fails; do not promote an add-back without a new selective factorization.
